world_state_reading: entity=issue/PR; state=(status,labels,assignee,milestone,locked) rendered text; action=real GH event (opened/closed/labeled/...)
action_extraction: coarse GH event action token; @0 single-entity slot
state_rendering: canonical sorted attribute-set sentences (mechanical state only, no prose)
ood_note: for an OOD-entity probe, convert two non-overlapping date ranges and use the later range as test (issues/repos created after the cutoff).
